Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals.

programme.title: Bitter Creek
programme.desc: A man (William Elliott) arrives in town seeking proof that a wealthy rancher is responsible for his brother's murder.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Based on true events, this drama chronicles the attempts of Gene and Peg Mullen, an Iowa couple whose son Michael has been killed by American "friendly fire" in Vietnam, to hunt down the details of his death. When the U.S. government evades their direct questions, the Mullens spend years searching for the facts, and, as they gradually piece together events, they grow increasingly embittered toward the war that robbed them of their boy.

programme.title: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Inspector Hopkins calls on Holmes to help solve the murder of young Willoughby Smith.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.title: The Buckskin Lady
programme.desc: Gambler Angela Medley (Patricia Medina) is courted by local gunman Slinger (Gerald Mohr), but she has feelings for Dr. Bruce Merritt (Richard Denning). After her father hustles Merritt out of some money, Angela promises to repay him quickly. But she loses a card game against Slinger and gets herself further into trouble. Soon, Merritt thinks she is involved with the gunman. Distraught, Angela leaves town with Slinger, but the two men continue to fight over her, with serious consequences.

programme.desc: Earp agrees to resign to help Jim Kelley's chances at winning the mayoral election, but the replacement marshal soon faces a crisis when crooks trap Kelley in his store.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

Kurt Steiner leading the mission, aided by Liam Devlin, an Irishman with a deep hatred of England. As the plan unfolds, it seems to be going well -- until certain events threaten the group's shot at success.

programme.title: The Quick and the Dead
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger (Sam Elliott) befriends and protects a settler (Tom Conti) and his wife (Kate Capshaw) in 1876 Wyoming.

programme.title: Hangman's Knot
programme.desc: Major Matt Stewart (Randolph Scott) leads a troop of Confederate soldiers on a raid, targeting a wagon that is transporting Union gold. All the Union soldiers are killed except for one, who informs Stewart that the war had already ended a month ago. Stewart leads the troop into hiding, knowing they could face murder charges. After capturing a coach driven by nurse Molly Hull (Donna Reed), the soldiers try to evade a group of bandits chasing them to steal the gold.

programme.title: Angels Over Broadway
programme.desc: A boozing playwright (Thomas Mitchell) invests a clerk's loot in a poker game with two sharpers (Douglas Fairbanks Jr., Rita Hayworth).

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Near the end of the Korean War, a platoon of U.S. soldiers is captured by communists and brainwashed. Following the war, the platoon is returned home, and Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Laurence Harvey) is lauded as a hero by the rest of his platoon. However, the platoon commander, Captain Bennett Marco (Frank Sinatra), finds himself plagued by strange nightmares and, together with fellow soldier Allen Melvin (James Edwards), races to uncover a terrible plot.

programme.title: Mildred Pierce
programme.desc: When Mildred Pierce's wealthy husband leaves her for another woman, Mildred decides to raise her two daughters on her own. Despite Mildred's financial successes in the restaurant business, her oldest daughter, Veda, resents her mother for degrading their social status. In the midst of a police investigation after the death of her second husband, Mildred must evaluate her own freedom and her complicated relationship with her daughter.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.title: Apache Country
programme.desc: At the request of the U.S. President, Gene Autry (Gene Autry) goes undercover to infiltrate an outlaw gang that's been selling guns and alcohol to Native Americans as a way to cover up its own criminal activities. Autry and Buttram also receive help from Carolina Cotton (Carolina Cotton), who seeks revenge on Kilrain for killing her father.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

They offer the desperado amnesty for his previous crimes if he'll put his famous trigger finger to work for Texas. programme.title: Barbed Wire
programme.desc: The Texas cattle trails to Kansas have been obstructed by settlers stretching miles of barbed wire across their territories. Kansas-based cattle buyer Gene Autry (Gene Autry) goes to Texas to find out what gives. He discovers that a dispute between ranchers and settlers has been actively fostered by unscrupulous speculator Sandy Reeves (Harry Shannon), who will benefit from railroad construction across the land -- which he is scheming to possess. It's up to Gene to stop him.

programme.title: Paid Programming
programme.desc: Paid programming.

programme.title: Outlaw Women
programme.desc: A gambling queen (Marie Windsor) and her henchwomen run things until a U.S. marshal (Richard Rober) comes to town.

programme.title: Without Reservations
programme.desc: Famous author "Kit" Masterson (Claudette Colbert) needs an actor to portray the lead character, a soldier, in the upcoming movie version of her book. While on a train to California, she meets Marine Rusty Thomas (John Wayne) and his friend, Dink (Don DeFore). She begins to imagine the macho Rusty as the lead, and attempts to stay in his company. However, since Rusty did not like her book, Kit must conceal her identity, all the while growing more attracted to her potential actor.

programme.title: Paid Programming
programme.desc: Paid programming.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: A courageous newspaperman makes a stand when gamblers attempt to force the mayor to get rid of Marshal Earp.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The childish son of a rancher, forced to sell a herd for less than he'd planned, tries to make up his losses in a poker game.

programme.title: Blue Canadian Rockies
programme.desc: Montana rancher Cyrus Higbee (Don Beddoe) asks his foreman, Gene Autry (Gene Autry), to travel with Rawhide Buttram (Pat Buttram) to Higbee Lodge in Canada, where he suspects his daughter, Sandy (Gail Davis), is disregarding his orders by starting a dude ranch and disrupting the logging industry. Higbee also regards Sandy's fiancé, Todd (Ross Ford), as insincere. When they arrive, Gene and Rawhide are set upon by vengeful mill workers and Sandy's mysterious foreman, Pop Phillips (Tom London).

programme.title: The Deadline
programme.desc: A cowboy (Buck Jones) framed for murder gets out of prison and tracks down the real killer.

programme.title: Sierra Stranger
programme.desc: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

programme.title: Gun for a Coward
programme.desc: Three brothers -- no-nonsense leader Will Keough (Fred MacMurray), rebellious Harry (Dean Stockwell) and pacifist mama's boy Bless (Jeffrey Hunter) -- bend their family to breaking point as their differing personalities clash during a cattle drive. It doesn't help that Will and Harry think Bless is a coward, believing that his inaction during a violent situation got their father killed. When rustlers attack the Keough herd, Bless is forced once again into a dangerous confrontation.

programme.title: The Stalking Moon
programme.desc: While moving a group of Apaches to a Native American reservation in Arizona, an American scout named Sam Varner (Gregory Peck) is surprised to find a white woman, Sarah Carver (Eva Marie Saint), living with the tribe. When Sam learns that she was taken captive by an Indian named Salvaje ten years ago, he attempts to escort Sarah and her half-Native American son to his home in New Mexico. However, it soon becomes clear that Salvaje is hot on their trail.

programme.title: Double Indemnity
programme.desc: In this classic film noir, insurance salesman Walter Neff (Fred MacMurray) gets roped into a murderous scheme when he falls for the sensual Phyllis Dietrichson (Barbara Stanwyck), who is intent on killing her husband (Tom Powers) and living off the fraudulent accidental death claim. Prompted by the late Mr. Dietrichson's daughter, Lola (Jean Heather), insurance investigator Barton Keyes (Edward G. Robinson) looks into the case, and gradually begins to uncover the sinister truth.

programme.title: The Best Man
programme.desc: Secretary of State William Russell (Henry Fonda) lives by his principles, but is haunted by a recent sexual indiscretion that threatens both his marriage and his career. Senator Joe Cantwell (Cliff Robertson) presents himself as the people's candidate, yet his determination to win at all costs is also his great flaw. These two frontrunners for their party's presidential nomination vie for the support of the outgoing president (Lee Tracy), and resort to mudslinging in a very public contest.

programme.title: The Scarlet and the Black
programme.desc: Defying a Nazi colonel (Christopher Plummer), Vatican Monsignor Hugh O'Flaherty (Gregory Peck) hides thousands of escaped POWs in occupied Rome.

programme.title: Blue Montana Skies
programme.desc: Gene (Gene Autry), Frog (Smiley Burnette) and Steve (Tully Marshall) are Montana cattlemen who drive herds over the Canadian border. When Steve is killed, they follow a clue he carved on a rock, which leads to a nearby ranch run by Dorothy (June Storey). She's a good woman, oblivious to the fact that the sneering Hendricks (Harry Woods) is running a fur-smuggling ring under her nose, using her ranch as cover. It's up to Gene and Frog to save Dorothy, stop the outlaws and avenge their friend.

programme.title: Bandit Queen
programme.desc: A young woman (Barbara Britton) becomes a masked avenger after gold-grabbers kill her Spanish parents in old California.

programme.title: Colorado Sunset
programme.desc: Craving a respite from touring life, singing cowboy Gene Autry (Gene Autry) ; his sidekick, Frog (Smiley Burnette) ; and their band, the Texas Troubadours, purchase a dairy farm in Colorado. Settling into their new lives as dairymen, Gene and the boys discover that someone is attacking area milk trucks in a bid to drive the local dairies out of business. Teaming up against the corrupt sheriff (Buster Crabbe) and veterinarian (Robert Barrat), Gene and his men fight to save the farms.

programme.title: The Deadline
programme.desc: A cowboy (Buck Jones) framed for murder gets out of prison and tracks down the real killer.

programme.title: Sierra Stranger
programme.desc: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

programme.title: The Stalking Moon
programme.desc: While moving a group of Apaches to a Native American reservation in Arizona, an American scout named Sam Varner (Gregory Peck) is surprised to find a white woman, Sarah Carver (Eva Marie Saint), living with the tribe. When Sam learns that she was taken captive by an Indian named Salvaje ten years ago, he attempts to escort Sarah and her half-Native American son to his home in New Mexico. However, it soon becomes clear that Salvaje is hot on their trail.

programme.title: Rancho Notorious
programme.desc: Vern Haskell (Arthur Kennedy) is pushed to revenge when his fiancée is killed during a general store robbery. Intent on punishing those responsible, Vern manages to find one of the thieves, who is mortally wounded. In his dying words, the man gives Vern a clue to finding the others. Continuing his quest, Vern travels to the hideout -- a ranch operated by Altar Keane (Marlene Dietrich), a former saloon singer. By fooling an outlaw (Mel Ferrer), Vern makes his way into their inner circle.

programme.title: The Turning Point
programme.desc: Prosecutor John Conroy (Edmond O'Brien) is determined to bring down organized crime in his Midwestern town. He looks to his father, Matt (Tom Tully), a police officer, for help, but Matt refuses. John's childhood friend Jerry McKibbon (William Holden), an investigative reporter, senses something fishy and spies on Matt. Jerry learns that Matt is communicating with a gangster (Ed Begley), but hides his discovery from John. Instead, Jerry confides in John's girlfriend, Mandy (Alexis Smith).

programme.title: Sunset Boulevard
programme.desc: An aging silent film queen refuses to accept that her stardom has ended. She hires a young screenwriter to help set up her movie comeback. The screenwriter believes he can manipulate her, but he soon finds out he is wrong. The screenwriter's ambivalence about their relationship and her unwillingness to let go leads to a situation of violence, madness, and death.

programme.title: Breaker Morant
programme.desc: In South Africa during the Second Boer War, Australian Army Lieutenants Harry "Breaker" Morant (Edward Woodward), Peter Handcock (Bryan Brown) and George Witton (Lewis Fitz-Gerald) stand accused of the murders of six Boer prisoners and the assassination of a German missionary. British Commander-in-Chief Lord Kitchener is determined to see the men found guilty, which he can use as a bargaining chip in an impending peace conference with the Boers.

programme.title: Shotgun
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun.

programme.title: Comin' Round the Mountain
programme.desc: Dolores Moreno (Ann Rutherford) desperately awaits the arrival of the money she needs to pay the taxes on her ranch, but Gene Autry (Gene Autry), the Pony Express rider carrying the funds, gets waylaid by bandits along the way. Stranded in the desert, Gene comes across a wild mustang, lassos him, breaks him and rides him to Dolores' ranch. There, he teams up with her trusted ranch hand, Frog (Smiley Burnette), to figure out a way to save the property.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: While Dick Melaney and his Cheyenne wife, Laura, visit Dodge City, a lecherous man confronts Laura, forcing her to shoot him; Laura retreats to find protection with her father, a chieftain who wants Dick to kill the man who assaulted her.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid in Old New Mexico
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid (Duncan Renaldo) and Pancho (Martin Garralaga) free a girl (Gwen Kenyon) accused of murder, then find the killer.

programme.title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
programme.desc: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

programme.title: The 77 Percent
programme.desc: 77 per cent of Africa's population are below the age of thirty-five yet their interests are under-represented poltically and economically. This show aims to redress the balance by providing a voice to the largest demographic group on the continent. These dynamic younger people are politically engaged and will determine the future path their countries, and the continent as a whole, will follow in the twenty-first century. Presented by Eddy Micah Jr. from Ghana and Wanjiku Mwaura from Kenya, the show promotes a pan-African agenda by encouraging dialogue between the various interested parties. The show pulls no punches when delivering its compelling reports, personal accounts and provocative discussions. A long overdue look at the big issues that affect the youth of Africa.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies
programme.desc: (2015) Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance star in Steven Spielberg's Cold War spy drama. After gaining notoriety for defending a Soviet spy, a US lawyer then tries to free a CIA pilot.

programme.title: Glory
programme.desc: (1989) Matthew Broderick, Denzel Washington and Morgan Freeman star in Edward Zwick's epic, Oscar-winning tribute to the first Black regiment raised in the North during the Civil War.

programme.title: Shame
programme.desc: (2011) Steve McQueen's adults-only drama about a good-looking, well-dressed and successful Manhattan tech exec who's addicted to sex. Starring Michael Fassbender and Carey Mulligan.

programme.title: Hilary and Jackie
programme.desc: (1999) Fact-based drama about the lives of the troubled genius, cellist Jacqueline du Pré (Emily Watson) and her sister Hilary (Rachel Griffiths). With David Morrissey. Strong language.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: (1943) There was an old boat - a post office that floats - that got dragged into the war. When it was torpedoed, in the seawater flowed. Can it deliver the mail any more? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: (1954) A surgeon on the wild frontier, must save the Kiowa nation, by curing their malaria on a high-plains reservation. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: (1954) In a derelict gold mining town, poor John Fuller is trapped underground. The Apache are near, so the danger is clear. For three drifters, the only way's down. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: (1956) Ingrid Bergman's ingénue is chosen by Yul Brynner, to hoax the Russian royal court - but has he picked a winner? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: (2005) Two brothers play a game and get plunged deep into space. Can they get back home, past a hostile alien race? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: The Holdovers
programme.desc: (2023) It's not cool to be stuck at school for Christmas. But can teacher and pupil get on after all, despite pedagogical fuss? With Paul Giamatti as one of the literati. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
programme.desc: (2022) Joe's a bad survivalist - he really hasn't got the gist. He wants deer for his cooking pot, but it's Lone Wolf that ends up shot. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Never Grow Old
programme.desc: (2019) Gritty revisionist western with Emile Hirsch as an undertaker who's somewhat conflicted when an outlaw played by John Cusack starts dropping bodies in a previously God-fearing town.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: (1950) Western with Randolph Scott and Dorothy Malone. A cunning US Marshal pretends to be a doofus to get a bank robber to take him to the hidden loot.

programme.title: Broken Arrow
programme.desc: (1950) Western starring James Stewart. A gold prospector, tired of reprisal killings between whites and Native Americans, offers a truce to the Apaches' leader. But tensions resurface.

programme.title: Reap the Wild Wind
programme.desc: (1942) Period melodrama. John Wayne, Ray Milland and Paulette Goddard star in this tale of fierce rivalries engendered by love and seemingly deliberate shipwrecking in 19th-century Florida.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: (1957) Classic sci-fi horror about the perils of radiation. A normal-sized fella gets a lot, lot smaller when he breathes in a mysterious mist. Definitely not one for arachnophobes!

programme.title: The Kid Who Would Be King
programme.desc: (2019) Fantasy adventure. A 12-year-old from modern-day suburbia finds King Arthur's sword Excalibur and must save the country from a sinister sorceress. With Patrick Stewart.

programme.title: Nobody
programme.desc: (2021) Action thriller with Bob Odenkirk. He's just a dad who goes to work and takes out the trash. But really he's an ex-assassin about to unleash his true self... and take out the trash.

programme.title: The Menu
programme.desc: (2022) Horror with Ralph Fiennes and Anya Taylor-Joy. Only one diner at an exclusive eatery sees through the foam quenelles to the pile of steaming prairie oysters beyond. Mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: (2019) Sharp, eccentric murder-mystery starring Daniel Craig as a detective anonymously hired to investigate the death of a wealthy writer (Christopher Plummer). With Ana de Armas.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol

programme.title: The Yellow Mountain
programme.desc: (1954) Western. Lex Barker and Howard Duff star as prospectors whose friendship is tested when a promising seam of the gold is discovered in a Nevada mountain. With Mala Powers.

programme.title: The Sheriff of Fractured Jaw
programme.desc: (1959) Comedy western with Kenneth More. An English gunsmith decides the Wild West is the best market for his wares, but little does he expect to end up sheriff of a lawless frontier town.

programme.title: Earthquake
programme.desc: (1974) Disaster drama. The people of Los Angeles struggle for survival when a massive earthquake hits the city. Starring Charlton Heston, Ava Gardner, Victoria Principal and Walter Matthau.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: (2004) All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programme.title: Die Hard 2
programme.desc: (1990) Thriller with Bruce Willis. Cop John McClane is in trouble at Washington's Dulles Airport, where an ex-CIA renegade plans to free a South American drugs baron.

programme.title: The Fury
programme.desc: (1978) Brian De Palma's supernatural horror with Kirk Douglas, John Cassavetes, Andrew Stevens and Amy Irving. A shadowy agency abducts a young man with telekinetic powers.

programme.title: The Vourdalak
programme.desc: (2023) Darkly comic Gothic horror about the travails of a foppish emissary of the King of France in a gloomy forest inhabited by a very odd family. With Kacey Mottet Klein. In French/subs.
